skills.delivery_notes: Two-stage: arrow projectile places a poison gas cloud at ground target (1.8m -> +80% radius over 4s; limit 6 clouds); any fire/ignited-enemy contact DETONATES the cloud in a large fire explosion (100% phys-to-fire on detonation). Dominant every-3s loop is the DETONATION -- the large-zone fire blast at cloud position -> ground_targeted_circle. The cloud-placement projectile is the arming stage (noted). fire primary (detonation) + earth secondary (poison gas). burn (ignite) + poison ailments.
